synonyms: VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream
Vden
synopsis: Twenty-year-old former wage slave Yuki Tanaka now works among her idols: the streamers of Live-On, one of Japan’s top VTuber companies. As the gorgeous, polite Awayuki Kokorone, she delivers only the most ladylike content. Unfortunately, her subscriber count and savings are at rock bottom. One evening, after Yuki thinks she’s ended her stream, she cracks a few cold ones—and more than a few crude jokes—while watching Live-On’s video archives. But her viewers hear it all, and clips of her bawdy, drunken commentary go viral overnight. Yuki thinks her career is over...until her manager reveals that everyone at Live-On has been waiting for her to snap all along and gives her free rein to drink on-stream. Now free of all feigned purity, she jumps right into her new “rowdy drunk” character and is welcomed into the fold by her fellow Live-On VTubers, who turn out to be just as crazy as she is! With her views and finances skyrocketing, Yuki’s work—for the first time in her life—is actually fun! (Source: J-Novel Club) Note: In the September 2025 issue of Comp Ace magazine, it was announced that due to various circumstances, the manga has been discontinued.

synopsis: Planetary Doctors: The ability of a model planetary human made to imitate a planet spreads to the world and becomes a disease, and people who suffer from the disease. And the people who wanted to be planetary people and the people who didn't want to be planetary people. All beings modeled after planetary humans are called 'planetary'. Hwangji and his party try to solve and rectify the 'planetary' that arises due to them, but the world moves as if it were set and does not stop. (Source: Naver, translated) Note: Chapter count includes a Prologue

title: Shoujo Seikan Hyouryuuki
titleRomaji: Shoujo Seikan Hyouryuuki
titleNative: 少女星間漂流記
synopsis: A spaceship in the shape of a horse-drawn carriage travels across the galaxy. Riding in the carriage is Ridley, the scientist who built this eccentric spaceship, and her partner Watari, a shy girl. The two leave Earth, which has become uninhabitable due to environmental pollution, and set off in the carriage. Their goal is to find a safe planet to settle. However, all the planets they visit are very strange! A planet with a god who can bring all things back to life, another planet where the luckiest people are considered the greatest, and a planet with countless libraries… The two girls are sometimes thrown for a loop by these strange worlds… Even today, they continue to explore the vast galaxy. "Maybe the next world will be the one to settle on." (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)
